tracks.title: Meeting for the museum visit

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: 土曜日に博物館へ行きませんか。
turns.english: Would you like to go to the museum on Saturday?

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: いいですね。何時に会いますか。
turns.english: Sounds good. What time shall we meet?

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: 午前九時に駅で会いましょう。
turns.english: Let's meet at the station at nine in the morning.

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: 博物館へは何で行きますか。
turns.english: How will we get to the museum?

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: 駅から電車で行きます。
turns.english: We'll go by train from the station.

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: わかりました。土曜日の午前九時ですね。
turns.english: Understood. Nine on Saturday morning, then.

comprehensionPrompts: Where are the two people planning to go?
How will they travel from the station?

tracks.title: Sunday bus trip to the aquarium

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: 日曜日の水族館へのバスは何時ですか。
turns.english: What time is the bus to the aquarium on Sunday?

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: 午前十時に駅の前から出ます。
turns.english: It leaves from in front of the station at ten in the morning.

turns.speaker: female
turns.english: It's three hundred yen one way.

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: 友達と行きます。二人分をお願いします。
turns.english: I'm going with a friend. Two tickets, please.

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: はい。二枚で六百円です。
turns.english: Certainly. Two tickets are six hundred yen.

comprehensionPrompts: What is the destination of the Sunday bus?
How much is one one-way ticket?
